attributes.summary: v0.4.0 (v0.3.1 configuration, re-timed picks) re-inverted with tomoDD's event updates floored at the local solid surface (D-B081 floor in the inversion, D-B083); product as D-B076: medium (rock / water / air at the D-B068 merged surface), D-B073 shallow-crust node rule, Vp_tomography / Vs_tomography = the inversion values, NonLinLoc grids by the field rule. Three-dimensional Vp and Vs of the Cascadia margin and Juan de Fuca / Gorda plates from double-difference local-earthquake tomography (tomoDD-SE) of the offshore-onshore ensemble catalog (OBS and land picks), on the tomoDD node grid (interior nodes). Depth in km below sea level, positive down.

attributes.shallow_crust_rule: D-B073 at the nodes (2-km-node approximation of the field rule): rock nodes (medium 0) in offshore columns (coast-scan mask of b4_time_grids.offshore_mask on the 1 km Lambert lattice, coast_run_km 5, cuts [[47.9, 48.75, -124.55], [46.1, 46.4, -124.05]], at the lattice column containing the node), below sea level and at most 2.5 km below the merged seafloor at the node (depth + surface_elevation <= 2.5): Vs = min(Vs_tomography, Vp_tomography / 2.1). Nodes above the seafloor are water (no rule). The NonLinLoc grids carry the exact field rule (1 km lattice cell centres)
attributes.shallow_crust_node_note: the node values carry a 2-km-node approximation of the rule; the NonLinLoc grids (v0.4.1_nll) carry the exact field rule; read_velocity_model.py evaluates the field rule at any point from v0.4.1_surface_lattice.nc
attributes.floor_in_inversion: D-B083: tomoDD-SE event updates stopped 1 m below the conservative floor of the D-B068 merged surface (D-B081 floor, surface.dat per stage: M0 45 s, tiles 30 s cell minimum - 1 m); events at the floor kept and flagged, Air_dep out of the way (-1000 km); velocities above the surface rock-continued during the inversion
attributes.nll_frame: Earth-flattened, cell-centred SLOW_LEN on the 1 km D-B005 Lambert lattice: depth axis z' = Re ln(Re / (Re - z)), velocity v' = v Re / (Re - z), Re = 6371 km (as the v5.1 travel-time grids)
